toolbarMatchingRules.css: cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); padding: 8px 13px;
border-radius: 9px; font-weight: 500; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-color: rgb(223, 232, 227); transition: background 0.16s, border-color 0.16s, box-shadow 0.16s;
height: var(--control-height); min-height: var(--control-height); padding-block: 0px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
height: var(--control-height); min-height: var(--control-height); padding: 0px 9px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; white-space: nowrap;

line-height: 1.3; height: var(--control-height) !important; min-height: var(--control-height) !important; max-height: var(--control-height) !important; border-radius: var(--control-radius) !important; padding-block: 0px !important;
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;
font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; gap: 0.357143rem; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; font-size: var(--text-small) !important;
border: 1px solid var(--control-border); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: var(--control-shadow);

toolbarMatchingRules.selector: body button, body button.ui-button, body .card, body .time-template-chip, body .notification-tab svg, body input, body select, body textarea
